theorem_title: A valid prefix count fits the sparse-query word bound
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffixValueBounds.prefix_count_le_word {h J k t : ℕ}
    (pMod shift : ℤ) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (C : Finset γ)
    (a : α → ℤ) (b : β → ℤ) (c : γ → ℤ) (w : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.Wanted h J α)
    (pre : List (Finset (Fin (464*h)))) (hk : k ≤ J) (hp : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StoredReporting.ValidPrefix w.2.2 k pre)
    (hkey : w.1 ∈ A ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.globalModulus h J ∣
      (a w.1 % pMod+_root_.ThreeSum.RawIncidences.lift w.2.1*pMod+shift)-_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.globalKey w.2.2)
    (hvalueWord : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightSparseQuery.magnitudeBound (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockIndexedQuery.suffixStage J (464*h) k) (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockIndexedQuery.suffixStage J (464*h) k)
      (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBlockQuery.residualSize h J k) t B.card C.card : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) :
    (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.prefixQuery (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawIncidences.rawOn h J pMod shift (A ×ˢ (B ×ˢ C)) a b c) w k pre : ℤ) ≤ lim.word := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let finite source sets $A,B,C$ carry integer values, let $w$ be a wanted label satisfying membership and its exact shifted lifted-key divisibility condition, and let $p$ be a valid prefix at depth $k\le J$. If the stated sparse-query magnitude bound for the suffix stage, residual size, threshold $t$, and source cardinalities fits the word limit, then the exact prefix-query count for the corresponding raw-incidence set also fits that limit.

Connects semantic nonnegative prefix counts to the stored signed-query arithmetic bound. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
